data.one_liner: Conditionally wrap a widget with a parent widget.
data.what_it_does: Conditionally wraps a child widget with a parent widget based on a boolean condition. It provides a parentBuilder and an optional parentBuilderElse to avoid repetitive ternary statements in the widget tree.
use_when: You need to conditionally wrap a subtree with a parent widget inside a build method.
You want to avoid verbose ternary operators or if-else statements when returning widgets.
avoid_when: You require a package that is actively maintained.
Complex state management is needed instead of simple conditional tree wrapping.
strengths: Keeps widget tree code clean and readable.
Supports an optional parentBuilderElse for handling the false condition.
weaknesses: The package is stable but not actively maintained.
